people.name: Flavio Maria De Paoli
people.statement: Turns heterogeneous data and cloud services into reusable, inspectable data and AI pipelines.
people.bio: Associate Professor at DISCo and public contact for the DatAI laboratory. His documented research includes service-oriented and cloud computing, distributed systems, semantic data enrichment and data/AI pipeline engineering. Recent public outputs connect his work to enRichMyData, DataPACT, SemT, SemTUI, LamAPI and Prompt2DAG.

people.name: Andrea Maurino
people.statement: Studies how data quality and large-scale data management shape dependable information systems.
people.bio: Full Professor at DISCo. His public research record covers databases, data quality, large-scale data management and semantic technologies. Institutional and European records document scientific responsibilities in APM, DIPPS, COMSODE and SMART, alongside contributions to euBusinessGraph on company-data modelling and knowledge-graph quality.

outputs.name: Decoding the mind: A RAG-LLM on ICD-11 for decision support in psychology

people.name: Michele Ciavotta
people.statement: Designs service and edge–cloud architectures for adaptive data and AI pipelines.
people.bio: Associate Professor at DISCo. His publications span service and cloud computing, semantic data enrichment, data pipelines and federated edge systems. Public evidence connects his work to enRichMyData and DataPACT-related results, as well as SemT, Prompt2DAG and the DFaaS architecture and prototype.

people.name: Matteo Luigi Palmonari
people.statement: Builds knowledge-graph and document-analysis methods that make data easier to interpret and reuse.
people.bio:
Matteo Palmonari is an Associate Professor at the Department of Informatics, Systems and Communication of the University of Milano-Bicocca and a member of the DatAI Lab. His research lies at the intersection of data management and artificial intelligence, with a focus on semantic data integration and enrichment, knowledge graphs, knowledge-intensive NLP and large language models, and neuro-symbolic AI. His recent work investigates the integration of structured knowledge and large language models, with applications in knowledge-intensive domains such as the legal domain.

He has led the University of Milano-Bicocca team in several European and national research and innovation projects, including DataPACT, enRichMyData, euBusinessGraph, EW-Shopp, the PRIN project *Discount Quality for Responsible Data Science*, and Next Generation UPP. He was the coordinator of the H2020 project EW-Shopp and scientific manager of the Horizon Europe project enRichMyData.

people.name: Blerina Spahiu
people.statement: Studies how knowledge-graph structure and quality can be made measurable and useful to people.
people.bio: Researcher at DISCo. Her public publications focus on knowledge graphs, semantic data quality, profiling and summarisation. ABSTAT is the clearest documented result: a pattern-based knowledge-graph profiling approach evaluated through published studies and user-centred analysis.

outputs.name: User perceptions of knowledge graph quality dimensions in cultural heritage

people.name: Carlo Batini
people.statement: Connects data quality, conceptual modelling and service design across information systems.
people.bio: Retired Full Professor at the University of Milano-Bicocca and senior member of DatAI. His documented research spans databases, conceptual modelling, data quality, information systems and service science. Institutional records connect his work to the SMART programme on user-value-oriented e-government services.

outputs.name: VCL: Bridging Natural Language and Structured Control for Domain-Specific Document Analysis

people.name: Abubakari Alidu
people.statement: Explores service-based tabular enrichment and LLM-assisted generation of data pipelines.
people.bio: Doctoral researcher at DISCo. His public research outputs address tabular data enrichment and AI-assisted pipeline generation. SemT defines an enrichment-as-a-service framework, while Prompt2DAG studies modular prompting for generating data-pipeline DAGs.

outputs.name: LLM-Based DAG Creation for Data Enrichment Pipelines

people.name: Emanuele Petriglia
people.statement: Studies how cloud–edge workloads can be distributed and scheduled under changing demand.
people.bio: Doctoral researcher at DISCo. Public profiles and publications connect his work to cloud and edge computing, resource allocation, scheduling and distributed systems. His recent studies compare decentralized load-management strategies and reinforcement-learning approaches for workload distribution in Function-as-a-Service edge environments.

outputs.name: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Workload Distribution in FaaS-Edge Computing Systems
Comparing Actor-Critic and Neuroevolution Approaches for Traffic Offloading
Analysis and Evaluation of Load Management Strategies in a Decentralized FaaS Environment

people.name: Federica Filippini
people.statement: Designs adaptive resource-allocation methods across the computing continuum.
people.bio:
Federica Filippini is a post-doctoral researcher at the Department of Informatics, Systems and Communication of the University of Milano-Bicocca. She received her M.Sc. degree in Mathematical Engineering and her Ph.D. degree cum laude in Information Technology from Politecnico di Milano.

Her research interests focus on optimization and resource management in Cloud, Edge, and distributed computing environments. Her work addresses resource selection, allocation, and scheduling problems for heterogeneous and dynamic computing infrastructures, including Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) and the Edge-Cloud Computing Continuum. She is also interested in performance modeling and workload management, as well as in the application of Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning techniques to resource orchestration, workload distribution, and task offloading for Artificial Intelligence and Agentic AI applications. More recently, her research has explored imitation learning and reward design for Reinforcement Learning approaches applied to decentralized routing in satellite constellations, as well as to general constrained optimization problems. Her research aims at developing adaptive and efficient optimization and learning-based approaches for the dynamic management of resources and decision-making in complex distributed systems.

outputs.name: Tabular Reinforcement Learning Methods for AI Tasks Offloading in Smart Eye-Wears
Performance Modeling in FaaS Workloads at the Edge Using Machine Learning
Decentralized Edge Workload Forecasting With Gossip Learning

people.name: Marco Cremaschi
people.statement: Develops semantic-table and entity-linking methods for turning heterogeneous data into structured knowledge.
people.bio: Research contractor at DISCo, with public records documenting earlier fixed-term research activity. His publications focus on semantic table interpretation, entity linking and data enrichment. Public DataPACT results and the MammoTab25 paper directly document recent work on large-scale semantic table interpretation datasets.

outputs.name: stEELlm: An LLM for Generating Semantic Annotations of Tabular Data
How good are LLMs in disambiguating entities in tabular data?

people.name: Riccardo Pozzi
people.statement: Designs entity-centred methods for analysing complex document collections with verifiable evidence.
people.bio: Research contractor at DISCo. His public work includes knowledge-intensive document analysis, knowledge-graph and NLP methods, and factuality-oriented generation. DAVE and ReFactX are recent peer-reviewed outputs that directly connect his work to the laboratory's document-analysis line.

outputs.name: An entity-centric approach to manage court judgments based on Natural Language Processing

people.name: Renzo Arturo Alva Principe
people.statement: Studies how long documents can be represented, classified and explored with knowledge-aware language technologies.
people.bio: Research Fellow at DISCo. His doctoral thesis examined representation and processing of long documents in the transformer era. Public outputs include DAVE, ABSTAT-related research and knowledge-graph and NLP methods for document and investigation analysis.

outputs.name: Long Document Classification in the Transformer Era
Understanding the structure of knowledge graphs with ABSTAT profiles
